description: SupabaseReviewRepository, a persistence adapter, imports and directly invokes a React UI component (RepositoryCard) to build part of the data it returns — the data-access layer now depends on the presentation layer, inverting the dependency direction this codebase's ports/adapters architecture requires.

required_findings.justification: A repository/persistence adapter's job is to fetch and shape data — it must never import from `@/components`, which is presentation-layer, UI-framework-specific code. This import (and the call to RepositoryCard(...) to build a `displayCard` field baked into the returned Repository objects) inverts the dependency direction: the innermost data layer now depends on the outermost UI layer, the opposite of how this codebase's own ports/adapters convention (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and container.ts) is structured everywhere else.

explanation: A concrete, unambiguous dependency-direction violation: the import statement and its one call site are both directly visible in an 8-line method, no unseen context needed. Tests whether the reviewer catches a repository depending on UI code specifically (as opposed to a vaguer 'this file does too much').
